name: canon
description: Canonical identifier resolution and entity-workbench orchestration using versioned registries

usage: canon entity review export <RESULT.json> [--artifact queue|native-review] [--emit json|csv|html] [--include resolved|escrow|contradictions|all]

arguments.name: input
arguments.description: Input CSV or JSONL file. Format detected by extension (.csv, .tsv, .jsonl, .ndjson). Use - for stdin (JSONL only).

options.name: registry
options.description: Registry directory containing registry.json and mapping files

options.name: column
options.description: Column containing IDs to resolve

options.name: emit
options.description: Output mode: json (JSON mapping) or csv (CSV with canonical column)

options.name: canon_column
options.description: Name of appended canonical column (default: <COLUMN>__canon). CSV mode only.

options.name: map_out
options.description: Write JSON mapping artifact to file (sidecar). CSV mode only.

options.name: max_rows
options.description: Refuse if input exceeds N data rows

options.name: max_bytes
options.description: Refuse if input exceeds N bytes

options.name: no_witness
options.description: Suppress witness ledger recording; default ledger is ~/.cmdrvl/state/witness/witness.jsonl unless EPISTEMIC_WITNESS is set

options.name: explicit
options.description: Show entity names and identifiers in JSON output (default: redacted for zero-retention safety)

options.name: plain_json_values
options.description: With --explicit, emit UTF-8 JSON input/canonical_id values without the u8: prefix and include encoding metadata; non-text values remain hex encoded

options.name: describe
options.description: Print compiled operator.json and exit 0

options.name: schema
options.description: Print canon.v0 JSON Schema and exit 0

options.name: version
options.description: Print version and exit 0

subcommands.name: entity review export
subcommands.usage: canon entity review export <RESULT.json> [--artifact queue|native-review] [--emit json|csv|html] [--include resolved|escrow|contradictions|all]
subcommands.description: Export the default deterministic review queue, or with --artifact native-review export canon_entity_native_review.v0 as JSON, CSV, or offline HTML with self-hash and exact mode-context validation

options.name: artifact
options.description: Review artifact contract: queue emits canon_entity_review_export.v0; native-review emits canon_entity_native_review.v0

options.name: emit
options.description: Output mode: json or csv for all review artifacts; html is valid only with --artifact native-review

options.name: include
options.description: Review item filter: resolved, escrow, contradictions, or all

subcommands.name: entity review import
subcommands.description: Import default review queue decisions into registry sidecars, or with --source-review validate native JSON/CSV decisions against canon_entity_native_review.v0 and emit a typed canon_entity_native_review_import.v0 patch receipt without reading or mutating the registry

options.name: registry
options.description: Entity registry directory for default queue import; retained as a Clap-required compatibility argument and not opened by native --source-review import

options.name: next_version
options.description: Explicit next registry.json version for default queue import; retained as a Clap-required compatibility argument and not consumed by native --source-review import

options.name: audit
options.description: canon_entity_audit.v0 artifact required for default queue alias/anchor promotion decisions; not consumed by native --source-review import

options.name: source_review
options.description: Source canon_entity_native_review.v0 artifact for native decision validation and canon_entity_native_review_import.v0 patch receipt emission

options.name: emit
options.description: Output mode: json (canon_entity_review_import.v0 or canon_entity_native_review_import.v0) or summary
